subathon.started.description: Runs when a subathon timer starts (from its starting length). Good for announcing the subathon in chat.

fields.timer: Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer.

variables.elapsed: Seconds it has run so far
variables.formattedElapsed: Time it has run so far, like 1:30:00
variables.multiplier: The multiplier for event time (1 = normal)

subathon.paused.description: Runs when a subathon timer is paused, by hand, by a sub-action or because your stream ended.

fields.timer: Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer.

variables.elapsed: Seconds it has run so far

subathon.resumed.description: Runs when a paused subathon timer carries on.

fields.timer: Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer.

subathon.ended.description: Runs when a subathon timer reaches 0:00:00. Good for ending the stream (an OBS sub-action), a raid or a big thank you.

fields.timer: Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer.

variables.elapsed: Seconds the subathon ran in all

subathon.timeAdded.description: Runs every time time is added to (or taken from) a subathon timer: by a sub, bits, a tip, a follow, a raid, a reward or by hand. Good for a "+5:00" alert or a thank you.

fields.timer: Only for this timer. Leave it empty for every timer.

variables.seconds: Seconds added (negative when time was taken away), after the multiplier
variables.user: Who added it (empty when it was added by hand)
variables.reason: What added it, like Subscription, Cheer, Follow, the reward's name or Manual

goals.pointsAdded.description: Runs every time points are added to (or taken from) a goal.

fields.goal: Only for this goal. Leave it empty for every goal.

variables.user: Who added them (empty when added by hand)
variables.reason: What added them, like Subscription, Cheer or Manual
variables.nextStep: The name of the next step (empty when every step is reached)
variables.nextStepPoints: The points the next step needs
variables.pointsToNext: How many more points the next step needs

goals.stepReached.description: Runs once when a goal reaches one of its steps, like "New emote" at 10 points. Each step runs it only once, even if points go down and up again (until the goal is reset). Good for an alert or a chat message.

fields.goal: Only for this goal. Leave it empty for every goal.

variables.step: The step's name, like New emote
variables.stepNumber: Which step it is (1 = the first)
variables.nextStep: The name of the next step (empty when this was the last)
variables.nextStepPoints: The points the next step needs

goals.completed.description: Runs when a goal reaches its last step.

fields.goal: Only for this goal. Leave it empty for every goal.

subathon.control.description: Starts, pauses, carries on or resets a subathon timer. Good for a Stream Deck button or a mod-only !pause command.

fields.timer: The timer's name. Leave it empty for the first timer.
fields.mode: Start = start it (or carry on after a pause). Pause = stop the clock. Resume = carry on. Pause or resume = switch between them. Reset = stop it and put back its starting length.

subathon.addTime.description: Adds time to a subathon timer, or takes it away with a negative number. Good for your own events, like a donation goal or a game event. The timer's longest length still applies.

fields.timer: The timer's name. Leave it empty for the first timer.
fields.seconds: How many seconds, like 300 for 5 minutes. A negative number takes time away.
fields.useMultiplier: Ticked: the timer's multiplier is used (double time in happy hour).

variables.secondsAdded: The seconds really added (less when the longest length was reached)

subathon.setTime.description: Sets how much time a subathon timer has left.

fields.timer: The timer's name. Leave it empty for the first timer.
fields.seconds: The time left, in seconds, like 3600 for one hour.

subathon.multiplier.description: Changes how much event time counts, like 2 for a double-time happy hour, or 0.5 when the timer is filling up too fast. Time already added does not change.

fields.timer: The timer's name. Leave it empty for the first timer.
fields.multiplier: 2 = double, 1 = normal, 0.5 = half, 0 = events add nothing.

subathon.get.description: Gets a subathon timer's time left and state, for a !timer command.

fields.timer: The timer's name. Leave it empty for the first timer.

variables.subathonElapsed: Seconds it has run so far
variables.subathonFormattedElapsed: Time it has run so far
variables.subathonAdded: Seconds that have been added in all

goals.addPoints.description: Adds points to a goal, or takes them away with a negative number. Steps reached on the way up run the Goal step reached trigger.

fields.goal: The goal's name. Leave it empty for the first goal.
fields.points: How many points. A negative number takes points away.
fields.useMultiplier: Ticked: the goal's multiplier is used.

goals.setPoints.description: Sets a goal's points. Steps reached on the way up run the Goal step reached trigger (once each).

fields.goal: The goal's name. Leave it empty for the first goal.

goals.reset.description: Puts a goal back to 0 points, so every step can be reached again.

fields.goal: The goal's name. Leave it empty for the first goal.

goals.multiplier.description: Changes how much event points count, like 2 for double points or 0.5 when the goal is filling up too fast. Points already added do not change.

fields.goal: The goal's name. Leave it empty for the first goal.
fields.multiplier: 2 = double, 1 = normal, 0.5 = half, 0 = events add nothing.

goals.get.description: Gets a goal's points and its next step, for a !goal command.

fields.goal: The goal's name. Leave it empty for the first goal.

variables.goalNextStep: The next step's name (empty when every step is reached)
variables.goalNextStepPoints: The points the next step needs
variables.goalPointsToNext: How many more points the next step needs
variables.goalSteps: Every step, like 10: New emote, 20: Second emote
